en: A black‑and‑white vintage postcard depicting a tree‑lined residential street with ornate townhouses and fenced front gardens on the left, and a wide, nearly empty road stretching into the distance on the right. Two men stand beside a bicycle on the sidewalk. The scene has an old European urban feel. Printed captions read "Nijmegen" at the lower left and "Batavierenweg" at the lower right.
